;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests#20 July|2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] engage in a gunfight with [[Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades|Hamas' military wing]] after an Israeli soldier is killed by a [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] sniper; four Hamas members are killed. Israel responds to the incident with strikes on [[Hamas]] targets across [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-44908358 (BBC)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/07/20/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-violence.html (''The New York Times'')] 
**Three rockets are fired at [[Israel]]i communities from Gaza. Two of them are intercepted by the [[Iron Dome]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/20/middleeast/israel-launches-attack-in-gaza/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture 
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**[[James Gunn]] is fired as the director of ''[[Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3]]'' after the emergence of old tweets where he joked about subjects like pedophilia and rape. [http://time.com/5344997/james-gunn-fired-old-tweets/ (''Time'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[list of shipwrecks in 2018|Marine accidents in 2018]]
**An [[Australian Transport Safety Bureau]] investigation into the collision between [[container ship]] MV ''Beijing Bridge'' and [[fishing trawler|trawler]] FV ''Saxon Onward'' concludes both vessels saw each other in the lead-up to the collision but neither took appropriate avoiding action in time, with evasive manoeuvres by the cargo ship increasing the collision risk. [https://www.maritime-executive.com/article/container-ship-s-evasive-action-increased-collision-risk#gs.rG2Hbq8 (The Maritime Executive)]
*Smoke from a brush fire reduces visibility and the [[Ontario Provincial Police|OPP]] temporarily closes a 130-kilometre section of [[Ontario Highway 17]] between [[Mattawa, Ontario|Mattawa]] and [[Petawawa]], the primary route of the [[Trans-Canada Highway]] through the province. [https://ottawacitizen.com/news/local-news/opp-close-130-km-stretch-of-highway-because-of-smoke-from-brush-fire ''(Ottawa Citizen)'']

;Law and crime
*[[Impeachment of Park Geun-hye]]
**Former [[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Park Geun-hye]] is sentenced to an additional eight years for abusing state funds and violating election laws. [https://www.cbc.ca/amp/1.4754622 (CBC)]
*A man attacks people on a bus in [[Lübeck]], [[Germany]], prompting an evacuation of the vehicle. Six people are hurt by a knife, one is punched and two fall down; three are critically wounded. Police find a smoldering non-explosive backpack at the scene. The Iranian-born suspect is arrested. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44904183 (BBC)] [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/german-bus-attack-injuries-1.4754803 (CBC)] [https://www.rferl.org/a/iranian-born-man-with-knife-injures-10-in-attack-on-german-bus/29379017.html (RFERL)]
*[[Security hacker|Hackers]] steal the personal data of 1.5 million [[Singapore]]ans through the national public health care system. Officials say Prime Minister [[Hsien Loong Lee]]'s data is the target of the breach. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/singhealth-health-system-hit-serious-cyberattack-pm-lee-target-10548318 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[Microsoft]] reports that at least three [[United States]] [[United States Congress|congressional candidates]] have been targeted by hackers in the lead-up to the [[2018 midterm elections]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-44898505 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
* [[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]], [[Narendra Modi]] wins a [[Motion of no confidence in India|no confidence motion]] in the [[Lok Sabha]] tabled by the opposition.
[https://www.livemint.com/Politics/q87OONLQkzSIGTrzgJWKXN/Noconfidence-motion-Modi-govt-Live-updates-from-Parliament.html (Mint)]
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]]
**Outside President [[Hassan Rouhani]]'s office in [[Tehran]], a group of [[Iran]]ian girls severely burned in a 2012 school fire protest unequal [[diyah]] by the government toward their medical bills, which some say is an inalienable right. Their lawyer says Iran's policy of paying half diyah to women is "unfair and discriminatory". [http://www.payvand.com/news/18/jul/1071.html (''PayvAnd'')]
*[[People's Party (Spain) leadership election, 2018]]
**The XIX Congress of the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]] begins, which will elect the new party leader and successor of former [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Prime Minister of Spain|Prime Minister]] [[Mariano Rajoy]]. The candidates are former [[Deputy Prime Minister of Spain|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Soraya Sáenz de Santamaría]] and the party's deputy secretary of communication, [[Pablo Casado]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics/at-crossroads-spains-ousted-conservatives-pick-new-leader-idUSKBN1KA25I (Reuters)]
